title: Revive Ticket Totems
description: Changes the Totem of Undying texture to look like TDS revive tickets!
body:
This resource pack simply replaces the boring & old Totem of Undying with a much more awesome and infamous item for any Tower Defense Simulator players, the revive ticket!

**Disclaimer:** If you can't seem to find the totem in your creative menu while using this pack, it's because it doesn't only change the totem texture, but also the name of it, from "Totem of Undying" to "Revive Ticket"!
